parameters.query: SELECT asset_id,hostname,ip_address FROM cmdb_assets WHERE asset_type='perimeter' AND recon_authorized=true;
SELECT asset_id,open_ports_json FROM attack_surface_baseline WHERE scanned_at=(SELECT MAX(scanned_at) FROM attack_surface_baseline);

meta.description: Runs authorized port scans on owned perimeter assets daily. Diffs against baseline. Alerts on new open ports or services.
